decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to remove accessories like cases and chargers. I focused on reputable audio brands with high ratings and specific use cases. The JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) stood out for its 4.7 rating and portability. The EWA (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) was considered for its value, and the Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) and Onyx 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) for premium sound. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Go 3 because it offers the best balance of brand reliability, waterproof durability, and an affordable price point for a portable speaker.
